summary: Hadron Energy filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a presentation it will give at the Advancing Standards Transforming Markets Conference on the HALEU Fuel Cycle. The presentation discusses the Halo-10 LW-MMR reactor technology. No special-situation transaction—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, management change, or similar—is announced or implied. The 8-K is a routine disclosure of investor materials, therefore it does not qualify as a special situation.
